title: Elena of Avalor
description: The story of a brave teenager who has saved her kingdom from an evil sorceress and must now learn to rule as a crown princess until she’s old enough to be queen.

episodes.title: S1-E11Elena and the Secret of Avalor

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x1
episodes_data.description: On the day Elena officially becomes Crown Princess, she must rescue her sister Isabel from aboard a missing ship.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x2
episodes_data.description: Elena is torn between a promise she made to help Isabel and fulfilling her royal duties as crown princess.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x3
episodes_data.description: Elena finds herself at odds with the Grand Council when dealing with a magical rock whose anger can trigger a “monfuego” eruption.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x4
episodes_data.description: While the castle is preparing a surprise party for Esteban, Elena and Mateo take him sailing to an island where the Fountain of Youth is located. Elena and Mateo must save Esteban when he drinks too much water and becomes younger.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x5
episodes_data.description: On the night Elena decides to appoint Mateo as Royal Wizard of Avalor, an evil malvago and old enemy of Alakazar named Fiero turns her family and the citizens to stone. Mateo must put his skills to the test to stop Fiero and save the people of Avalor

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x6
episodes_data.description: Elena visits the Kingdom of Cordoba to oversee construction of a bridge between it and Avalor but is convinced by lazy and spoiled Prince Alonso to shirk her royal duties. Elena must save the kingdom when the digging awakens a totem giant from Mayan folklore named the Yacalli.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x7
episodes_data.description: During an archeological dig, Esteban accidentally releases a mischievous duende, a magical elf-like creature based on Latino folklore, who sets out on a mission to unleash hundreds of other duendes on Avalor.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x8
episodes_data.description: Elena attends her first Royal Retreat as Crown Princess and learns that it is more important to do what is right than to fit in after a clashing disagreement with one of her fellow rulers.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x9
episodes_data.description: On Dia de los Muertos, Elena discovers her ability to see ghosts and sets out to help the spirit of a woman mend the rift between her grandchildren and save the family restaurant.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x10
episodes_data.description: When a moth fairy tries to bring "the gift of eternal darkness" to Avalor during a solar eclipse, Elena must learn how to control the magic in her royal scepter.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x11
episodes_data.description: Elena laments how she was trapped in the magical Amulet of Avalor for forty-one years, until she was set free by a brave young Princess: Sofia The First.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x12
episodes_data.description: Elena brings all the communities of Avalor together to share each other's holiday traditions. But when a Doña Paloma scheme causes an overly competitive atmosphere, Elena sets off on a traditional "parranda" and carols through the city to remind everyone of the true spirit of Navidad.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x13
episodes_data.description: Elena helps coach Gabe when he joins Avalor's Royal "olaball" team despite being a terrible player.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x14
episodes_data.description: Skylar is chosen to help train three young jaquins on defending the kingdom of Avalor.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x15
episodes_data.description: On Isabel’s first day of school, she tries changing herself in order to fit in on a field trip to the Crystal Caverns.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x16
episodes_data.description: Elena enters a fencing tournament disguised as "Knight Elezar" to prove that she is a great fencer.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x17
episodes_data.description: Naomi's mom gets a new job in their old kingdom. Naomi and Elena try to convince her not to move the family away from Avalor.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x18
episodes_data.description: Esteban’s childhood friend, Victor, returns to Avalor during the kingdom’s Carnaval celebration and convinces Esteban to help him rob the royal treasury.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x19
episodes_data.description: When Elena finds out that her best friend Naomi's sixteenth birthday is coming up, she decides to throw her a Royal Quinceanera at the palace! But when Naomi becomes obsessed with having the perfect party, their friendship is put to the test.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x20
episodes_data.description: Elena must rescue Mateo when an unruly spirit monkey launches him into the Spirit World.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x21
episodes_data.description: Mateo takes on an apprentice, but soon discovers teaching is harder than it looks.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x22
episodes_data.description: Elena travels to the realm of the jaquins, but unknowingly puts Avalor in danger.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x23
episodes_data.description: Elena and her sister Isabel must work together to help undo a curse when an explorer is turned into a gecko.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x24
episodes_data.description: Elena and her friends get stranded on a sailboat and are rescued by a mysterious ship.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x25
episodes_data.description: Elena and her friends are transformed into sculptures!

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 1x26
episodes_data.description: Elena must work with Doña Paloma to break a spell.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 2x1
episodes_data.description: On Día de los Muertos, Elena meets a Maruvian ghost named Amaláy who stands watch over the powerful Jewel of Maru.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 2x2
episodes_data.description: Elena invites a princess from a neighboring kingdom to Avalor hoping to repair an old alliance.

episodes_data.title: Elena of Avalor 2x3
episodes_data.description: When Captain Sandoval retires, a skill competition is used to select his successor. Gabe is possessed by the spirit of a sword of a former General called El Guapo and acts like a jerk during the competition.
